results.evidence: Fourth pass (2026-09-30), web only, no DB read; still one spot-specific author (USFS); no ops. NEW ANGLES, none decisive: (1) Mountain Project: the five ROUTE pages (Artic Rose, Astral Projection, Astroglide, Asymptotic, Half Fast) carry no parking/pass/fee text, and the comment feeds for the area and all five routes are empty; the parent Skykomish Valley area page has no parking/pass/permit text either. (2) theCrag: no Washington Half Moon Crag entry (only Kananaskis, Red River Gorge and Mount Rubidoux namesakes). (3) The Mountaineers: no activity, trip report or route/place listing for Half Moon Crag (only the Seattle gym of that name). (4) Weekend Rock Washington (Whitelaw): the Internet Archive holds a scan, but it is a restricted lending item and its search-inside returns Item not available without borrowing (not logged in, not bypassed). (5) Wenatchee Outdoors Stevens Pass commuter hikes: no mention of Tye Road, the hairpin or a pass. (6) CascadeClimbers search: only the gym directory entry. (7) Seattle Times mile-by-mile Stevens Pass guide: live page answers with a bot challenge (not bypassed) and the Wayback Machine holds no snapshot. (8) WTA pass statements on Tye Road (Wellington Ghost Town, Iron Goat) are about the Wellington/Iron Goat trailheads, already listed fee sites, not this pull-off; the Skykomish district pages found (North Fork Skykomish, PCT Stevens North) are USFS and other sites. Washington Climbers Coalition and Access Fund have no page for this crag (WCC already checked in r7). Net: no source other than USFS (its Region 6 fee-site list omits the pull-off; FS 6099 page has no fee section) speaks to a pass at the Tye Road hairpin pull-off, so the two-source rule is not met. Owner note unchanged: the row contradicts itself (access.notes not a developed fee site, access.parking_pass no fee site identified, passRequired Recreation pass); if a second source appears the op is passRequired Recreation pass -> a no-pass value on these five rows only; access.fees and access._raw untouched.
